### Compliance by TwelveLabs - Video compliance review powered by rules you control [...] Compliance by TwelveLabs is a SaaS application that reviews your video library against rules your team writes, not ours. It ingests footage, applies your own compliance rule packs, and returns reviewer-ready findings with context, not just a timestamp and a label. Powered by TwelveLabs' Pegasus model, it explains why a moment may violate a rule so reviewers can accept, reject, or annotate in one queue.
